name: Voxel Format Handling
definition: Flexible voxel format support allowing 8-bit or 16-bit field sequences. Distinguishes between memory voxels (in memory) and pipeline voxels (in EM-Cube pipelines).
summary: Voxel format handling converts memory voxels into pipeline-ready formats via transformations, distinguishing itself by supporting flexible, user-defined field sequences and modular shader binding unlike rigid renderers.
